input.summary: Plunge through the top to open the gate. Repeat the lit spinner and upper-left bonus rollover until base bonus reaches 100K, then complete the four-bank and collect Double Bonus at the right saucer.

quickInfo.name: Gate
quickInfo.summary: A successful plunge opens the upper gate for returns to the top lanes and spinner area.

quickInfo.name: Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Ten-point switches toggle the spinner between 100 and 1,000 per spin; use it for repeatable points and top access when lit.

quickInfo.name: Four-bank
quickInfo.summary: Complete the four drop targets once to light Double Bonus at the right saucer.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Collect the lit right saucer to double the end-of-ball bonus.

quickInfo.name: 100K bonus
quickInfo.summary: The spinner and upper-left advance-bonus rollover raise base bonus to a displayed 100K maximum before Double Bonus.

steps.text: Plunge through the lit top route to open the gate.
Read the spinner lamp after slingshot or other 10-point hits. Repeat it when lit, and use upper-left rollover feeds to build base bonus.
Continue upper play until the displayed base bonus reaches 100K.
Complete the four drop targets once. Do not continue attacking a reset bank after Double Bonus is lit.
Shoot the right saucer to collect Double Bonus.
Return to the lit spinner and upper play. Protect the 200K end-of-ball bonus instead of forcing low-control targets.

fallback.title: Top-play bonus
fallback.when: Use this when the four-bank or right saucer rejects dangerously.

steps.text: Keep the upper gate open with controlled top entries.
Repeat the spinner and collect top lanes.
Score the spinner and upper-left advance-bonus rollover until base bonus reaches 100K.
Take Double Bonus only after the saucer feed is known.

alternatives.title: Fast Double Bonus
alternatives.when: Use this when the base bonus is already large and the four-bank is nearly complete.

steps.text: Finish the remaining drop targets from controlled shots.
Collect Double Bonus at the right saucer.
Return to the spinner and upper-left advance-bonus rollover until base bonus reaches 100K.
Score the lit spinner and upper-left advance-bonus rollover until base bonus reaches 100K.
Complete the four-bank to light Double Bonus.
Collect the lit right saucer.
Drain only after the displayed bonus and multiplier are secured.

techniques.name: Controlled spinner repeat
techniques.instruction: Use the open-gate return to regain the upper lanes. Repeat the spinner only while the return reaches a predictable flipper or top feed.

techniques.name: Saucer setup
techniques.instruction: Trap before the right-saucer shot. Aim for the center of the opening to reduce rejects.

techniques.name: Short Shatz pass to open the gate
techniques.instruction: Shatz pass softly through the left return lane to open the gate. Stop if the ball climbs far enough to enter the outlane.

cautions.issue: A cross-playfield shatz or spinner feed can send the ball toward an outlane.
cautions.response: Use the transfer only after its lane return is repeatable. Keep both flippers ready after a weak spinner shot.

cautions.issue: The right saucer can reject or eject unpredictably.
cautions.response: Test the saucer before you depend on Double Bonus. Use top play if the entry or eject is unsafe.

cautions.issue: Direct drop-target shots create fast center rebounds.
cautions.response: Finish the bank from controlled angles. Stop shooting it after Double Bonus is lit.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm ball count, Extra Ball and Special treatment, tilt consequence, and whether the right-saucer and outlane awards are enabled.
Read the spinner lamp after 10-point switch hits; it toggles between 100 and 1,000 per spin.
Test the spinner return, upper-left dribble, right-saucer entry and eject, left-sling kick, and outlane gate before choosing the route.
